## Ofalth (CR 10)

**XP** 9,600  
CE Large plant  
**Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., Perception +10  
**Aura** putrid stench (DC 21, 30 ft.)  


**Defense**


**AC** 24, touch 12, flat-footed 21 (+3 Dex, +12 natural, -1 size)  
**hp** 154 (11d8+66); fast healing 2  
**Fort** +13, **Ref** +8, **Will** +5  
**Defensive Abilities** filth wallow; **Immune** plant traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** 2 slams +15 (2d12+7 plus disease)  
**Ranged** offal +10 (2d10+10 plus disease)  
**Space** 10 ft.; Range 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** fling offal  


**Statistics**


**Str** 24, **Dex** 17, **Con** 23, **Int** 6, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 7  
**Base Atk** +8; **CMB** +16 (+18 bull rush); **CMD** 29  
**Feats** Cleave, Combat Reflexes, Improved Bull Rush, Lightning Reflexes, Nimble Moves, [Weapon Focus (slam)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (slam).*  
**Skills** Perception +10, Stealth +8 (+16 in garbage); **Racial Modifiers** +8 Stealth in garbage  
**Languages** Common (cannot speak)  
**SQ** freeze  


**Ecology**


**Environment** urban and underground  
**Organization** solitary or bloat (2-6)  
**Treasure** incidental  


**Special Abilities**


**Disease (Ex)** Wretched weeps; slam or offal—injury; *save* Fort DC 21; onset 1 day; *effect* 1d4 Str damage and 2d6 bleed; *cure* 2 consecutive saves. The save DC is Constitution based.  

**Filth Wallow (Ex)** An ofalth gains fast healing 2 in any area with a high concentration of debris, garbage or excrement, such as a landfill or sewer.  

**Fling Offal (Ex)** As a standard action, an ofalth may pick up a wad of refuse and throw it at an opponent. Treat this as a thrown weapon attack with a range increment of 30 feet. A creature struck by the offal takes 2d10 points of bludgeoning damage plus 1.5 times the ofalth’s strength modifier, and is exposed to the ofalth’s disease. If an ofalth is not in an area that can activate its filth wallow ability, it must tear off chunks of its own body to use this attack, taking 2d6 points of damage when it does.  

**Putrid Stench (Ex)** A creature that fails its save against an ofalth’s stench is nauseated 1 for 1d4+1 rounds. A creature that succeeds its save is sickened for 1 round, and is then immune to the stench of that ofalth for 24 hours. The save DC is Constitution based.
